description: Registry change history from stored registry_delta records, ordered by database timestamp and ID. Query with since (cursor or ISO8601), slug and limit (1..200). Source timestamps and coverage are included; records may be historical and do not prove current endpoint operation, payments or identity. 0.03 USDC on Base. [x402: 0.03 USDC per call on Base]

limit.description: Maximum stored events requested: advertised integer range 1-200, default 50. The current parser converts to an integer and clamps to 1-200; nonnumeric conversion fails. With no since it takes the recent tail, returned chronologically. This limit is not a freshness or coverage guarantee.

since.description: Exclusive cursor del_... or timezone-aware ISO8601 timestamp

slug.description: Optional exact stored-event slug filter. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; matching is by equality, not substring search. latest/last/recent/ultimos clear the filter; omitting it requests recent global stored events. This selects historical registry events, not live endpoint health.

name: registry_watch
